steps.action:
The sky appears blue due to a phenomenon called **Rayleigh scattering**, in which sunlight interacts with gas molecules in Earth's atmosphere. Because blue light has a shorter wavelength than other colors in the visible spectrum, it is scattered in all directions far more efficiently than red or yellow light. Our eyes perceive this scattered blue light coming from every part of the sky, making it appear blue across the entire dome above us.
